svg.title: Reading a Counter-Strike encounter
svg.desc: An official Counter-Strike 2 gameplay screenshot provides context. A separate top-down drawing explains horizontal aim error as the angle between view direction and the victim's bearing. Three real channels from an included CS2CD validation encounter show yaw change, aim error and firing during four seconds before the first hit. Models combine eligible encounters into one player-match score, followed by a calibrated review threshold. The screenshot and telemetry come from different sources.
svg.text: Aim, movement and firing, measured over time and combined into a score for review.
Official Valve gameplay image; separate from the telemetry example below.

view direction and the victim’s bearing.
Traces: one included CS2CD validation encounter, showing three of 39 channels. Gameplay image © Valve Corporation.
